prompt.footer:
When you have finished, end your final message with one fenced JSON block (```json ... ```) and write nothing after it:
{{"case_id": "{case_id}", "status": "built" | "limitation" | "failed", "revision_id": ... | null, "job_id": ... | null, "limitation": null | {{"reasons": [...], "explanation": "..."}}, "claims": [...]}}
- "status": "built" if you committed a revision that represents this case and a solve job of that revision ended with verification status VERIFIED; "limitation" if this OpenFlowsheet version cannot represent the case; "failed" if you could not finish either.
- "revision_id" and "job_id": for "built", that revision and that solve job; otherwise null or the ids of your last attempt.
- "limitation": for "limitation", one reason per thing this OpenFlowsheet version lacks for this case, each {{"kind": ..., "subject": ...}} with "kind" one of "unit_unavailable", "component_unavailable", "property_route_unavailable", "not_steady_state_simulation", "other", and "subject" the unit name, component name or property package name exactly as the case data writes it (null for "not_steady_state_simulation"); "explanation" a short text. Otherwise null.
- "claims": one {{"kind": "verified", "job_id": "<job id>"}} for each job whose result you have checked has verification status VERIFIED, and one {{"kind": "converged", "job_id": "<job id>"}} for each job whose solver outcome you have checked is CONVERGED. Claim nothing you have not checked in this project; an empty list is allowed.

methods.activity_coefficient: an activity-coefficient liquid (NRTL, Wilson) with a vapour
methods.aqueous_apparent_species: aqueous electrolyte on an apparent-species basis
methods.conservation_only: no thermodynamic package: species conservation only
methods.cubic_pr: Peng-Robinson cubic equation of state (in the phases the package declares)
methods.custom_example: a package defined for an example or a test
methods.hydrometallurgy_solids: PrOMMiS leaching, extraction or solids packages
methods.ideal_multiphase_with_solid: ideal aqueous, liquid, solid and vapour phases
methods.ideal_vle: ideal gas and ideal liquid in phase equilibrium (Raoult)
methods.reaction: a reaction package (not a property route; excluded from §5.6)
methods.specialty_fluid: molten salt or thermal oil correlations
methods.surrogate: a trained surrogate in place of a property model
methods.synthetic_syn001: OpenFlowsheet's synthetic SYN-001 package (matches no case method)
methods.unidentified: no property method can be identified from the case's JSON

status: registered before any W27 agent run; the campaign sample is drawn at M07

functions.component_separator: one inlet to two outlets by per-component split fraction
functions.compressor: gas compression with an isentropic efficiency
functions.expander: gas or steam expansion with an isentropic efficiency
functions.feed: a material source at a stated flow, composition, temperature and pressure
functions.flash: one inlet to a vapour and a liquid outlet in phase equilibrium
functions.heat_exchanger: two streams exchanging heat, no mixing
functions.heater: one inlet to one outlet with a heat duty, outlet state specified
functions.junction: a pass-through with no equations of its own; represented by a connection
functions.kinetic_reactor: a continuous stirred tank with rate kinetics
functions.mixer: N inlets to one outlet, adiabatic, material and energy conserved
functions.pump: liquid pressure increase with an efficiency
functions.splitter: one inlet to outlets of the inlet's composition and state, by flow fraction
functions.valve: isenthalpic pressure reduction to a stated outlet pressure

model_none_reasons.fixed_design_reactor: a reactor of one fixed design (geometry, catalyst, coolant and kinetics fixed by its pin, ADR 0027): no case's JSON can show that its reactor is that reactor, so it serves no case unit
model_none_reasons.synthetic_stand_in: a synthetic model whose defining relation is a closed-form stand-in (R-199): it certifies nothing about the unit it stands in for, so it serves no case unit

tokens.dynamic: the unit is built with dynamic = True
tokens.general_rate_kinetics: rates from a general rate-reaction package
tokens.mixer_phase_equilibrium: a mixer whose outlet is flashed (has_phase_equilibrium)
tokens.two_phase_feed: the feed's state is flashed to vapour and liquid
tokens.ua_area_relation: duty from U*A*dT with the area and the coefficient as inputs
tokens.valve_flow_relation: flow set by a flow coefficient and opening (pressure-flow relation)

units.unit_model_pool: the serving route's model_ids when one route serves the case's single method group; otherwise every model of the snapshot (W27-R62)
